channels.red: Hunter hair: anchored roots and free tips
channels.green: Horse mane and rein fringe; skull/eye protected
channels.blue: Grass clusters; weighted toward blade tips

camera: Fixed. No global image translation, zoom or parallax.
rain: Procedural depth layers moving down-right; integer-period trajectories for a seamless loop.
source_method: Imagegen clean plate removes painted rain; vector masks and code animate local regions.
cloak: Separate opaque grayscale texture; packed RGB masks stay opaque to preserve their data in browser decoding.
